units.rawText: At Reactor No. 3.
units.displayText: At Reactor No. 3.

spans.text: At Reactor No. 3.

units.rawText: [(〃＞皿＜) Run away, run away!]
units.displayText: [(〃＞皿＜) Run away, run away!]

spans.text: [(〃＞皿＜) Run away, run away!]

units.rawText: The mini-robot extends a mechanical arm and forcefully drags Helix outside.
units.displayText: The mini-robot extends a mechanical arm and forcefully drags Helix outside.

spans.text: The mini-robot extends a mechanical arm and forcefully drags Helix outside.

units.rawText: I can't...! We can't just leave like this! Banxsy's still, Banxsy's still...
units.displayText: I can't...! We can't just leave like this! Banxsy's still, Banxsy's still...

spans.text: I can't...! We can't just leave like this! Banxsy's still, Banxsy's still...

units.rawText: Helix looks fearfully up at that figure that still appears to be at ease, but is clearly looking more and more ragged.
units.displayText: Helix looks fearfully up at that figure that still appears to be at ease, but is clearly looking more and more ragged.

spans.text: Helix looks fearfully up at that figure that still appears to be at ease, but is clearly looking more and more ragged.

units.rawText: I have to help her... What should I do... Mini-Robot, what should I do?
units.displayText: I have to help her... What should I do... Mini-Robot, what should I do?

spans.text: I have to help her... What should I do... Mini-Robot, what should I do?

units.rawText: [Σ(⊙▽⊙"a Are you asking me?]
units.displayText: [Σ(⊙▽⊙"a Are you asking me?]

spans.text: [Σ(⊙▽⊙"a Are you asking me?]

units.rawText: Help me think of something! Aren't there defense mechanisms inside the reactor?
units.displayText: Help me think of something! Aren't there defense mechanisms inside the reactor?

spans.text: Help me think of something! Aren't there defense mechanisms inside the reactor?

units.rawText: [Σ(⊙▽⊙"a I really don't know, I'm just a mini-robot.]
units.displayText: [Σ(⊙▽⊙"a I really don't know, I'm just a mini-robot.]

spans.text: [Σ(⊙▽⊙"a I really don't know, I'm just a mini-robot.]

units.rawText: (Whimpers) Oh no... What should I do...
units.displayText: (Whimpers) Oh no... What should I do...

spans.text: (Whimpers) Oh no... What should I do...

units.rawText: Helix gets so frantic that her little face flushes red. She runs her hands up and down herself, in search of something that might prove useful–
units.displayText: Helix gets so frantic that her little face flushes red. She runs her hands up and down herself, in search of something that might prove useful–

spans.text: Helix gets so frantic that her little face flushes red. She runs her hands up and down herself, in search of something that might prove useful–

units.rawText: Ah– I've got it! The Energy Herbs! Right! The Energy Herbs!
units.displayText: Ah– I've got it! The Energy Herbs! Right! The Energy Herbs!

spans.text: Ah– I've got it! The Energy Herbs! Right! The Energy Herbs!

units.rawText: Mini-Robot, is there anything like a smelter inside the reactor?
units.displayText: Mini-Robot, is there anything like a smelter inside the reactor?

spans.text: Mini-Robot, is there anything like a smelter inside the reactor?

units.rawText: [(oﾟ▽ﾟ)o I know the answer to that! This way!]
units.displayText: [(oﾟ▽ﾟ)o I know the answer to that! This way!]

spans.text: [(oﾟ▽ﾟ)o I know the answer to that! This way!]

units.rawText: What rotten luck... (Pants) These guys...
units.displayText: What rotten luck... (Pants) These guys...

spans.text: What rotten luck... (Pants) These guys...

units.rawText: They're such a pain in the ass... At this rate...
units.displayText: They're such a pain in the ass... At this rate...

spans.text: They're such a pain in the ass... At this rate...

units.rawText: After glancing at the Entropics behind her, Banxsy draws a ragged breath as she skates along the complex maze of walkway handrails inside the reactor.
units.displayText: After glancing at the Entropics behind her, Banxsy draws a ragged breath as she skates along the complex maze of walkway handrails inside the reactor.

spans.text: After glancing at the Entropics behind her, Banxsy draws a ragged breath as she skates along the complex maze of walkway handrails inside the reactor.

units.rawText: Well, meeting my end in a place like this, dying in a sea of disgusting monsters... Uhm... How should I say this, it feels kind of artistic.
units.displayText: Well, meeting my end in a place like this, dying in a sea of disgusting monsters... Uhm... How should I say this, it feels kind of artistic.

spans.text: Well, meeting my end in a place like this, dying in a sea of disgusting monsters... Uhm... How should I say this, it feels kind of artistic.

units.rawText: Just as the notion of giving up begin to appear in Banxsy's mind, her nose twitches as she suddenly picks up a strange odor.
units.displayText: Just as the notion of giving up begin to appear in Banxsy's mind, her nose twitches as she suddenly picks up a strange odor.

spans.text: Just as the notion of giving up begin to appear in Banxsy's mind, her nose twitches as she suddenly picks up a strange odor.

units.rawText: This is...
units.displayText: This is...

spans.text: This is...

units.rawText: Clang–
units.displayText: Clang–

spans.text: Clang–

units.rawText: The Entropics crawling inside the reactor have an even more dramatic reaction. They stop and look down as one.
units.displayText: The Entropics crawling inside the reactor have an even more dramatic reaction. They stop and look down as one.

spans.text: The Entropics crawling inside the reactor have an even more dramatic reaction. They stop and look down as one.

units.rawText: What's that smell, Energy Herbs?
units.displayText: What's that smell, Energy Herbs?

spans.text: What's that smell, Energy Herbs?

units.rawText: Just as she freezes up, the Entropics cry out before turning as one to rush toward the smelter below them.
units.displayText: Just as she freezes up, the Entropics cry out before turning as one to rush toward the smelter below them.

spans.text: Just as she freezes up, the Entropics cry out before turning as one to rush toward the smelter below them.

units.rawText: Aiiieeeee! Run! Run away!
units.displayText: Aiiieeeee! Run! Run away!

spans.text: Aiiieeeee! Run! Run away!

units.rawText: [!!!∑(ﾟДﾟノ)ノ Beating feet! Beating feet!]
units.displayText: [!!!∑(ﾟДﾟノ)ノ Beating feet! Beating feet!]

spans.text: [!!!∑(ﾟДﾟノ)ノ Beating feet! Beating feet!]

units.rawText: ...Helix?!
units.displayText: ...Helix?!

spans.text: ...Helix?!

units.rawText: Inside a certain room within Reactor No. 3.
units.displayText: Inside a certain room within Reactor No. 3.

spans.text: Inside a certain room within Reactor No. 3.

units.rawText: [(〃＞皿＜) Arms... Not long enough...]
units.displayText: [(〃＞皿＜) Arms... Not long enough...]

spans.text: [(〃＞皿＜) Arms... Not long enough...]

units.rawText: Just a little more!
units.displayText: Just a little more!

spans.text: Just a little more!

units.rawText: The mini-robot and Helix use their arms and legs in unison to pile the tables and chairs in the room over the doorway until they're sure the Entropics can't bash it open easily.
units.displayText: The mini-robot and Helix use their arms and legs in unison to pile the tables and chairs in the room over the doorway until they're sure the Entropics can't bash it open easily.

spans.text: The mini-robot and Helix use their arms and legs in unison to pile the tables and chairs in the room over the doorway until they're sure the Entropics can't bash it open easily.

units.rawText: Whew, at last... At least I can rest now.
units.displayText: Whew, at last... At least I can rest now.

spans.text: Whew, at last... At least I can rest now.

units.rawText: Banxsy's body goes limp right as she says that and Helix grabs her.
units.displayText: Banxsy's body goes limp right as she says that and Helix grabs her.

spans.text: Banxsy's body goes limp right as she says that and Helix grabs her.

units.rawText: Ban... Banxsy?! Are... Are you alright?!
units.displayText: Ban... Banxsy?! Are... Are you alright?!

spans.text: Ban... Banxsy?! Are... Are you alright?!

units.rawText: Relax, I'm just a little worn out.
units.displayText: Relax, I'm just a little worn out.

spans.text: Relax, I'm just a little worn out.

units.rawText: These guys had me trapped for several days now. What are you doing here, anyway?
units.displayText: These guys had me trapped for several days now. What are you doing here, anyway?

spans.text: These guys had me trapped for several days now. What are you doing here, anyway?

units.rawText: I came with Miss Anna... They said you abandoned your post but I didn't believe them...
units.displayText: I came with Miss Anna... They said you abandoned your post but I didn't believe them...

spans.text: I came with Miss Anna... They said you abandoned your post but I didn't believe them...

units.rawText: Ah... Well, that's true. I've been trapped here for so many days, it's definitely been long past time since I took over.
units.displayText: Ah... Well, that's true. I've been trapped here for so many days, it's definitely been long past time since I took over.

spans.text: Ah... Well, that's true. I've been trapped here for so many days, it's definitely been long past time since I took over.

units.rawText: I knew it! I knew you wouldn't be so irresponsible and that something must have happened.
units.displayText: I knew it! I knew you wouldn't be so irresponsible and that something must have happened.

spans.text: I knew it! I knew you wouldn't be so irresponsible and that something must have happened.

units.rawText: (Coughs) Well... Anyway, we should think about how to get out of here.
units.displayText: (Coughs) Well... Anyway, we should think about how to get out of here.

spans.text: (Coughs) Well... Anyway, we should think about how to get out of here.

units.rawText: I don't know how so many Entropics snuck into the Helios Sector either.
units.displayText: I don't know how so many Entropics snuck into the Helios Sector either.

spans.text: I don't know how so many Entropics snuck into the Helios Sector either.

units.rawText: Was there a loophole?
units.displayText: Was there a loophole?

spans.text: Was there a loophole?

units.rawText: I don't know. In any case, this whole thing isn't normal.
units.displayText: I don't know. In any case, this whole thing isn't normal.

spans.text: I don't know. In any case, this whole thing isn't normal.

units.rawText: While you managed to draw their attention with the Energy Herbs, we're not getting out of here as long as those Entropics are blocking the entrance.
units.displayText: While you managed to draw their attention with the Energy Herbs, we're not getting out of here as long as those Entropics are blocking the entrance.

spans.text: While you managed to draw their attention with the Energy Herbs, we're not getting out of here as long as those Entropics are blocking the entrance.

units.rawText: That's true...
units.displayText: That's true...

spans.text: That's true...

units.rawText: Still, since you're here, it means the Oasis has sent someone to look for me, right?
units.displayText: Still, since you're here, it means the Oasis has sent someone to look for me, right?

spans.text: Still, since you're here, it means the Oasis has sent someone to look for me, right?

units.rawText: Yeah... But they still don't know how serious the situation is...
units.displayText: Yeah... But they still don't know how serious the situation is...

spans.text: Yeah... But they still don't know how serious the situation is...

units.rawText: Helix quickly narrates the events before this.
units.displayText: Helix quickly narrates the events before this.

spans.text: Helix quickly narrates the events before this.

units.rawText: Tsk, that Anna. She can be surprisingly slow when she isn't motivated.
units.displayText: Tsk, that Anna. She can be surprisingly slow when she isn't motivated.

spans.text: Tsk, that Anna. She can be surprisingly slow when she isn't motivated.

units.rawText: How about you? Did you bring your communicator along?
units.displayText: How about you? Did you bring your communicator along?

spans.text: How about you? Did you bring your communicator along?

units.rawText: Ah... I think I dropped it in the Admin Center...
units.displayText: Ah... I think I dropped it in the Admin Center...

spans.text: Ah... I think I dropped it in the Admin Center...

units.rawText: Honestly, you... You're smart, but careless...
units.displayText: Honestly, you... You're smart, but careless...

spans.text: Honestly, you... You're smart, but careless...

units.rawText: (Sniffle)
units.displayText: Sniffle

spans.text: Sniffle

units.rawText: Still, that's alright. If even you've gone missing as well, surely Anna would notice no matter how dumb she is, right?
units.displayText: Still, that's alright. If even you've gone missing as well, surely Anna would notice no matter how dumb she is, right?

spans.text: Still, that's alright. If even you've gone missing as well, surely Anna would notice no matter how dumb she is, right?

units.rawText: In any case, you sure helped me out a lot... Urk...!
units.displayText: In any case, you sure helped me out a lot... Urk...!

spans.text: In any case, you sure helped me out a lot... Urk...!

units.rawText: Banxsy suddenly grunts and her body twitches.
units.displayText: Banxsy suddenly grunts and her body twitches.

spans.text: Banxsy suddenly grunts and her body twitches.

units.rawText: Banxsy?! What's wrong?
units.displayText: Banxsy?! What's wrong?

spans.text: Banxsy?! What's wrong?

units.rawText: I... I'm fine...
units.displayText: I... I'm fine...

spans.text: I... I'm fine...

units.rawText: No, you're injured! You're hurt!
units.displayText: No, you're injured! You're hurt!

spans.text: No, you're injured! You're hurt!

units.rawText: Take off your jacket and show me!
units.displayText: Take off your jacket and show me!

spans.text: Take off your jacket and show me!

units.rawText: Don't get so worked up...
units.displayText: Don't get so worked up...

spans.text: Don't get so worked up...

units.rawText: Helix ignores her and pulls away the jacket Banxsy has tied around her waist, revealing her thigh. She sees the wound from a few days ago– not only has it not healed, but its edges are tinged with a faint purple color.
units.displayText: Helix ignores her and pulls away the jacket Banxsy has tied around her waist, revealing her thigh. She sees the wound from a few days ago– not only has it not healed, but its edges are tinged with a faint purple color.

spans.text: Helix ignores her and pulls away the jacket Banxsy has tied around her waist, revealing her thigh. She sees the wound from a few days ago– not only has it not healed, but its edges are tinged with a faint purple color.
